ModMetaData.name: What Can I Sell?
ModMetaData.author: Luís Sousa
ModMetaData.description:
Shows which of your items, prisoners, slaves and animals a settlement will buy, and lets you form a caravan with them already selected.
- "Things you can sell" button on settlements, and in the vanilla "Things this trader will buy" window - Lists only what you have that the trader wants - Shows how many you have, market value and estimated sell price - Pick a negotiator to see prices with their skill; they're added to the caravan - Only colonists allowed to trade there can negotiate, e.g. the Empire's required title - Tabs for items, prisoners and slaves, and animals - Search, and sort by value or name - Choose amounts, press "Form caravan", and the caravan window opens with them selected and the settlement set as the destination
You can't trade from this window, it is a planning tool. You will have to add colonists and travel supplies in the caravan window as usual.
Safe to add to or remove from existing saves.
